data_fields.name: zone_line_range
data_fields.donor_constant: 40000 (both lookups; effective bound is squared in one path)

data_fields.name: box_height
data_fields.donor_constant: row height (band from box z to z + height)

best_idea: A town exit as a zone-data row (position, target zone, keep-current sentinel, optional box) that the server looks up from its own position, and a death or gate that always returns to the bind slot 0 hub.
decision_why: Keep the nearest-exit lookup, the keep-current arrival and the home return, but compare true distances to a real range (the donor's range is effectively unlimited), refuse far requests instead of flagging them, and give boxes a depth as well as a width.
acceptance: A server test sends a zone request from 600 units away from any line to that zone and expects a refusal; a player inside a virtual box with z in band is moved to the box target; a death moves the player to bind slot 0 at the bind's coordinates.
